The '''SoroSuub land systems and proving grounds''' were a collection of tunnels and caverns located near [[G'rinn Go city]] that was used as a proving ground by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was one of the targets of [[Operation Thunderbolt]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
